prompt: A watercolor illustration depicts a bustling botanical greenhouse filled with lush greenery and distinct characters. On the far left, a tall man in a blue coat stands next to a large potted fern. Beside him, a woman in a yellow hat points at a hanging orchid. A small boy in striped shorts looks up at the woman, his hand resting on her knee. Near the center, an elderly gardener in overalls waters a cactus with a copper can. A brown dog sits patiently next to the gardener, watching a red ball roll away. To the right of the dog, a cat with white paws sleeps on a wooden bench. A girl in a pink dress reaches for a butterfly hovering near a sunflower. Behind her, a teenager in headphones leans against a glass pane, observing the scene. In the background, a vendor in an apron hands a seedling to a customer in a grey suit. A parrot perches on a metal stand nearby, tilting its head curiously. A basket of tulips rests on the floor next to the vendor. A watering can lies tipped over near the basket, spilling imaginary water. A ladder leans against the back wall, partially obscured by vines. A clock hangs above the entrance, showing midday. A pair of gardening gloves hangs from a hook on the right pillar. A notebook lies open on a table in the foreground, with a pencil resting on it. A coffee cup sits next to the notebook, steam rising faintly. There is no snow visible anywhere in the scene. There is no artificial lighting fixture hanging from the ceiling. There is no car parked inside the greenhouse structure.
